scenes: Bitcoin's creator sent one last email. Then he went silent.
And days later, the C I A came into the story.
December twenty ten. Satoshi made his last public forum post.
April twenty-third, twenty eleven. He emailed developer Mike Hearn.
I've moved on to other things.
It's in good hands with Gavin and everyone.
Around the same days, he wrote to Gavin Andresen.
I wish you wouldn't keep talking about me as a mysterious shadowy figure.
The press just turns that into a pirate currency angle.
On April twenty-seventh, Gavin announced a talk at the C I A.
Gavin later said his last email told Satoshi about that talk.
Satoshi is believed to hold about a million Bitcoin. Untouched.
